question: Why should fuller original provision govern an original agent’s actual productive role, rather than merely describe a more comprehensive optional accomplishment?
current_assessment: The current appraisal accepts the stronger source-mode norm defeasibly. The adverse appraisal and the norm’s separate evaluative burden remain explicit.
source_mode_norm: A qualified perfect original’s relevant actual provision has the excellence of adequate original provision without an irreducibly foreign positive original resource completing its concrete result.
positive_grounds: A maker that also provides preservation has a fuller actual causal role than a maker whose product needs an independently original preserver. Dar 013 gives the comparative premise substantive content beyond retaining a faculty to act alone.

The cumulative appraisal combines that comparison with the retained essential-original-sufficiency and practical-perfection framework. It judges unborrowed adequate provision fitting to the original mode of the agency actually exercised, rather than merely a larger optional accomplishment.

The stronger extension is a cross-locus philosophical reconstruction. It is not presented as a literal argument that every token act is eternally essential, that all possible acts must be realized, or that wisdom requires maximal production on every occasion.
strongest_preserved_objection: Being more complete in a specified role does not alone establish that every freely chosen original role must cover the entire result. A fitting, less comprehensive voluntary role might be compatible with an intact and intrinsically perfect agent.

If one original transforms material supplied by another, the material contributes to the external composition without necessarily efficiently completing the transformer’s intrinsic exercise. The causal classification establishes incomplete original coverage; calling that mode deficient requires the further evaluative premise.

The critic need not prove that a wise good uniquely requires an original peer. The question can be whether a less comprehensive role remains fitting even when a more comprehensive role is available. Failure to establish a peer-essential good is not itself proof of the norm.
current_response: The appraisal owns the evaluative extension explicitly. Its ground is the positive excellence of unborrowed adequate provision under the accepted original/practical-perfection framework. It does not hide the conclusion in a definition of the agent’s undertaking.

The adverse appraisal accepts substantial force in fuller responsibility while disputing the all-relevant-exercise extension. If its criticism is judged sufficient, causal nonduplication alone does not rescue the common-field conclusion.

A fitting later response can depend on an object, occasion or reason without receiving essential creative power from it. Causal roles can overlap. Calling a contribution an occasion does not erase a genuine positive resource, and counterfactual dependence alone does not prove donated agency.

premises: The declared field includes all relevant received productive resources. This completeness condition does not already identify one common source.
Every genuinely qualified original bearer receives the same relevant upstream qualifications. Efficient-only nonreceipt or an original label is not enough.
Connections used to propagate identity are genuinely productive. Agreement, knowledge, approval, proximity and covariance alone do not establish them.
Real original contributions remain attributable through subordinate created causes. Intermediate agency does not erase provenance.
field_propagation.conditional_result: Under those premises, the source-mode norm excludes irreducibly divided original completion, and causal nonduplication excludes the residual alleged repetition of entire production. Faithful mediate attribution and productive connection support one common original source throughout the declared field.
limitations: Structural propagation cannot establish its own local coverage norm.
No new empirical map of every productive connection is supplied.
The argument does not require finite ancestry or universal temporal well-foundedness.
The field conclusion does not establish numerical uniqueness of every necessary reality beyond the field. Disconnected or idle candidates require separate appraisal.
Common productive origin does not authenticate a messenger, determine an assertion’s meaning or grant operational permission.
